summary.text: Adrielle Camuel is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 93 since November 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Adrielle Camuel was born in and lives in Kentucky.
She earned a B.A. and a master's degree in political science from the University of Louisville.
Her career experience includes working as a small business employee and as an administrative professional at Fayette County Public Schools.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Banking and Insurance, Health and Family Services, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
